messages.content: I want a project memory I can switch on halfway through a coding session.
It can import the current transcript, then stay active for later Codex and Claude sessions.
It should be on demand and persist for a directory until I explicitly stop it.
Eventually I want a Tailnet home page listing project paths, but we have not built that part yet.
A shared SQLite store can hold activation, sessions, and the durable map.
The page should use React Flow and show how ideas branched out.
Open leaves can glow as the frontier; settled branches can stay quiet.
The current implementation is wrong because it is basically a chat log.
The point is to compress what was covered, not covered, planned, and unresolved into nodes.
We will make the project page a causal concept tree and keep transcripts only as source evidence.
Keep the design simple like the original, with no flashy sales text.
The interface will be a compact header, graph, controls, and node inspector.
